name: Ethiraj College for Women
summary: Ethiraj College for Women opened on 2 July 1948 in the former Hobart School for Muslim Girls in Royapettah. An autonomous college affiliated to the University of Madras, it is recognised by the UGC as a College with Potential for Excellence and was re-accredited A+ by NAAC in February 2023. Undergraduate programmes run in an aided stream and a self-supporting stream.
